description: Details pursuant to Schedule 1 Para 1.3.2 of the Section 106 Agreement relating to planning permission 22/2556/FUL dated 14.06.2024.
decision_conditions:
The following conditions and S106 obligations are triggered by first occupation of the development, and are yet to be discharged. You are advised of the requirement to discharge these conditions/obligations prior to commencing with first occupation of the development.

S106 Obligations:

•	Affordable Housing Unit Service Charge – Schedule 4, Part 1A, para 1.7 (only if Affordable Housing Units will be occupied)
•	Wheelchair User Units – Schedule 4, Part 1A, para 1.7 (only if the wheelchair units will be occupied)
•	Nominations Agreement – Schedule 4, Part 1A , para 2.1 (e) (only if any of the Social Rent Units will be occupied)
•	Substantial Implementation - Schedule 4, Part 1A , para 2.1 (e)
•	Substantial Implementation - Schedule 4, Part 2, para 4.7
•	Additional Affordable Housing Scheme - Schedule 4, Part 2, para 6.5 (iv)
•	Early Stage Review Viability Information - Schedule 4, Part 2, para 5.1
•	First Carbon Off-Set Contribution – Schedule 5, para 1
•	Car Club Membership – Schedule 6, paras 1.1 and 1.2
•	Open Space Contribution – Schedule 7, para 1
•	Restriction on applying for Parking Permits – Schedule 8, para 3
•	Playspace Contribution and the Playspace Maintenance Contribution – Schedule 10, para 1
•	River Restoration Contribution – Schedule 11, para 1
•	NHS Contribution Fee – Schedule 12, para 1
•	Highway Works – Schedule 13, para 1
•	River Crane Glazing Works Plan – Schedule 15, para 1.3

Conditions:

•	U0178993 Means of Enclosure: None of the buildings hereby approved shall be occupied until suitable means of enclosure have been erected along the boundary/ies of the site and between the approved houses and flats to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to construction. 
•	U0178996 Refuse arrangements: None of the buildings hereby approved shall be occupied until arrangements for the storage and disposal of refuse/waste have been made in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
